entities.summary: Wolfgang Popp is a former professional tennis player from Germany. He enjoyed most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career, he won one doubles title and finished runner-up an additional three times. He achieved a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 76 in 1987. Wolfgang Popp was a athletes & competitors from Neu-Isenburg (b. 1959-05-19, Neu-Isenburg). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
